book.name: Matai
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Matai byex o

content: Qayeeng pakeing wei vuweing lulul vei
Lek bouk kayon eno Yesu la myayaing veil xomek me la toundei wou lounyeing vi.
De xel qendu ngandoung ti qekuma vivekwou e om moxo lek la eivek bot ti me la dei eivek lalei, de xomaxoneing dalus on toukale nenyawes.
Woyom moxo neil lulul ngenong wou xel eivek qayeeng pakeing, me neil, “Xukana ti la vuw lul vei eivek xuk.
Ka moxo di vuw lul vei lala, eno valu teila lek sakwaing, me menek menek lam ya e ma.
De valu teila lek tembuing wei qakous o, en inyon tembuing nayaka toundei lek qakous mapu yon. Om belup daing me lam, en nambei tembuing on se la ghembi.
Ekom gyeik ingwei seiv leklam nale ghey, eno seiv leis vei yuvek lek me mupek, en luselis ma veil.
De vei valu teila senghoing eivek qeis wei yingying o om tyip me sevunexe lulul vei yon.
De vei valu teila lek tembuing nimza, me vuk neing teyei lek 100, me valu vuk 60 de valu 30 inye vati wei ev o.
Eti nenya nale lek e, ond wong e ngo.”
Xel betiyeing lam wou e me teling, “Nambei nya wang mi luk is xomaxoneing eivek qayeeng pakeing?”
Moxo neil elox bei, “Lupeyei nimza wei tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu wei mi yeip xupekeing eno Anutu wong wou xam dom se wong wou xel.

Eti yeiw wei liw nenyend wou a xe qayeeng petieing on tyek lupeyei gyeip yaing wou xel, me xel a qou lupeyei ngenong is. Ekom xel wei se mi ngo, eno lupeyei nayak wei xel qou yon eno tyek Anutu bouveil xel.
En qes tine om a mi luk wou xel eivek qayeeng pakeing.

content.text: “Xel mendghalus tyek gyei, ekom tyek xel se gyei lulti.
Me xel a ngo, ekom tyek xel se ngo wou me boulek qayeeng qes.

content: Om xel wong qayeeng wei poropet Yesaya neil eno wo neing lek.

content.text: “ ‘Tyek xam a ngo qayeeng lumama ekom tyek xam seng boulek.
Tyek xam a mi gwei lumama ekom tyek xam seng gwei lulti.
En xel xomaxoneing tine laleind wo nikanzek,
me xel on nenyend wo qatu
me boulek eivek naleind me pekwi me noum,
de tyek a bong xel bo nimzalek.’ Yesaya 6:9-10

content: Ekom xam Anutu e bong mata wou xam, en nambei xam mamimghalus yei ay me nambei xam nenyamim ngo wou qayeeng.
A neil wou xam zonghek bei xel poropet ngenong me xel moux wei bombek eno embei gyei vati wei xam ghe wei gweimbeeng ekom xel se yei, me xel embei ngo vati wei xam ghe ngo gweimbeeng ekom xel se ngo.
“Woyom ngo wou vati wei qayeeng pakeing neil en xukana vuw vei eno qes.
Gyeik xelti embei ngo qayeeng ne en tete lalei me se boulek nei, on tambiy ka nilul eno lam me tetei vati wei xend eivek e lalei yo veil. Vei tine inye vei wei vuw lek sakwaing o.
De vei wei teila lek tembuing wei qakous qakous, eno inye tambiy wei ngo qayeeng me lutika eno qou is lalei nimza me wo xeilala yo.
Ekom luselis wei e yo ma om nale nayaka. Gyeik nimaying wei xel mi pesek qayeeng o nimaying wei xomaxoneing wo nol wouma en Anutu xe xoulek eno lam, lutika eno moxo saing e xe wongeingis.
De vei wei teila eivek qeis wei yingying o, eno inyon tambiy wei ngo qayeeng, ekom wounalei en mapieing tine me lul dalus wei tembuing eno sevunexe om se vuk neing.
Ekom vei wei teila lek tembuing nimza yon, inyon tambiy wei ngo qayeeng me woulek. Moxo vuk neing teyei lek 100 o 60 o 30 inyon vati wei xend o.”
Qayeeng pakeing en vyaing
Yesu neil qayeeng pakeing nge wou xel no. “Tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu yon nambei tambiy ti vuw vei nimza eivek e xe xuk o.
Ekom ka xel dalusateiv yeip, e xe xel vevek amba lam me vuw vyaing eivek wit masenghoing dom la veil.
Ka wit tyip me lu belup, woyom vyaing tyip is ambei nyon.
“Xukma xe xukxe lam wou e me neil, ‘Teiv, beip wa seng vuw vei nimza eivek wa xe xuk? De woyom vyaing beimambei ne lam anghei inya?’
“Moxo neil elox bei, ‘Vevek amba ti lam wong tine.’ “Xel xukxe teling wou e, ‘Wambei xa na me na puw veil?’
“Moxo lewexe bei, ‘Ma, en nambei wa bei puw vyaing eno tyek wa puw wit luselis is.

Wong luw xouing ling deka bouk wei qoueing neing o le. Lek bouk kayon eno tyek a neil wou xel wei mi qou neing o, “Xam a puw vyaing atax me na tup buing en nyuweing, woyom xam qeku wit me na qou me nam eivek a xe xomek yaeing.” ’ ”
Qayeeng pakeing wei mastet vei me yis o
Moxo neil qayeeng pakeing nge wou xel no: “Tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu eno nambei mastet vei, wei tambiy ti qou me xen eivek e xe xuk o.

Inyon nayakameng ka veil vei dalus, ekom gyeik ingwei tyip ngandoung, inyon ling ngandoungateiv ghanaw lul dalus wei ev eivek xuk me wong ngandoung nambei xax, omek menek menek wei senghoing bandaing nei mi lam me qo lewis lek mema mema.”
Yesu lox neil qayeeng pakeing nge no, “Tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu yon nambei yis wei xel vex mi qou me maleeng eivek palawa me wong palawa vuklek me wo ngandoung.”
Yesu mi luk ti beimambei ne dalus wou xel qendu ngandoung on eivek qayeeng pakeing. Moxo se mi neil qayeeng ti yeipyaing wou xel qe mi neil eivek qayeeng pakeing.
Om nambei nyon kwa tine la teyei lek lulti Anutu neil eivek poropet mya.

content.text: “Tyek a tax myang en neileing qayeeng pakeing.
Tyek a neil pavulek en lul leimalei wei mindei xupekeing takwei wei tembuing lam nale yanyateiv o me elam gweimbeeng ne.” Qapiya Lalo 78:2

content: Qayeeng pakeing qes wei vyaing o
Woyom moxo ghanaw xel qendu yon me la eivek xomek. E xe xel betiyeing lam wou e me neil, “Neil e yeip yaing wou xa en qayeeng pakeing qes wei vyaing tyip eivek xuk o.”
Moxo lewexe bei, “Tambiy tiwei vuw vei nimza yon, inyon Xomaxoneing Neu Moux.
Xuk on tembuing sapa, de vei nimza yon teyei lek neuyeiw wei tete lalei yo. De vyaing on Sandang neuyeiw,
me vevek amba wei vuw xel on inye tambiy kawei mapetok o. De bouk wei qoueing neing on inyon bouk wei embei na tip lek o, de xel wei embei qou neing eno inye xel angela.
“Ka xel a puw vyaing me banyuw lek nenyex, yon tyek xel bong ambei nyon lek bouk loxyus.
Xomaxoneing Neu Moux tyek bong e xe xel angela na myayaing nei, me tyek xel a puw lul dalus wei mi wong sewokeing mi tyip o me xel dalus wei mi wong nilul ayang eno veil e xe tete lalei.
Tyek xel banex xel na eivek nenyex ngandoung de nanghei inyon eno tyek xel deeng me zanga newound bo nyiknyik.
Woyom xel wei bombek o tyek na siing ambei sayeiv eivek tete lalei wei xel Mend xe yo. Tambiy ti nenya nale lek e, ond wong e ngo.
Qayeeng pakeing en vuneing qoupek malew me viyaviy

“Tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu nei nambei xel vun qoupek wei malew eivek xuk ti. Gyeik tambiy ti yeiwou, eno la vun no, de woyom moxo wo xeilala me la wong vateivek lek lul dalus wei e yo dom la xouv xuk tiyon.
“Nge no, tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu eno nambei tambiy wei mi wo vateivek lek lulul o ti eno di yimexe viyaviy nimzamza.
Gyeik moxo yeiwou ingwei nimza maseim o ti, moxo la me wong vateivek lek e xe lul dalus de la xouv.
Qayeeng pakeing wei lewek o
“Nge no, tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu yon nambei lewek wei xel nex e teila eivek lounyeing me qou woing leimalei dalus o.
Lewek on pup, xel wei mi qou woing eno puw e leklam yasewis. Woyom xel dei tembuing me beyal woing wei nimza me toung eivek pasik ngenong, dom xel nex nilul o la.
Tine inye vati wei tyek qandi lek bouk loxyus o. Angelayeiw tyek nam me beyal xel wei nilul o veil xel wei bombek o
me banex xel na eivek nenyex ngandoung wei tyek xel na mi deeng me zanga newound bo nyiknyik o.”
Yesu teling, “Xam ghe woulek lul dalus ti beimambei ne?” Xel lewexe, “Ee.”

Moxo neil wou xel bei, “Nambei nyon xel putoung tambak wei petieing wei woulek tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu eno nambei xomek ti ma wei qou e xe lul wei xomek vateivek o me lul wei takwei me vako eno is me qou de lam myayaing.”
Poropet wei lei maeing o
Yesu neil qayeeng pakeing ti beimambei ne ma, moxo la veil inyon.
Moxo la beeng qes, me teyoxe xomaxoneing eivek xel xe xomek qekueing ama, om xel etek. Xel neil, “Xomaxoneing ne qou kwa ti beimambei ne nanghei inya me di wong lulvako ne?
Beip inye se kamunda neu? De ta se lei Maria, me Jems, me Yosep me Simon me Yudas eno se e liyeiw?
Beip inye e liyeiw vex se toundei is xey? Woyom moux tine qou lulti beimambei ne dalus nanghei inya?”
De xel laleind wo maying en e. Ekom Yesu neil wou xel, “Eivek e maxow beeng qes me eivek e maxow xe xomek inyon poropet wei lei maeing o.”
Om moxo se wong lulvako ngenong ti nanghei inyon, en nambei xel xe wongeingis eno ma.
